# POST /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/dependencies

Make the issue in the URL depend on the issue specified in the body

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-209`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `IssueMeta`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |

| `index` | int64 | True | positive integer |
| `owner` | string | True |  |
| `repo` | string | True |  |

## Response

**201** — *api.Issue

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | issue ID |
| `index` | int64 | issue index |
| `title` | string | issue title |

- **400** — Cross-repository dependencies not enabled
- **404** — Issue not found, repo not found, dependencies disabled, no write perm on target, no read perm on dependency
- **423** — Target repository is archived

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Cross-repository dependencies must be enabled in settings for cross-repo dependency creation | validation | form.Owner != ctx.Repo.Repository.OwnerName || form.Name != ctx.Repo.Repository.Name |
| Target repository must not be archived and must have dependencies enabled | validation | target.Repo.IsArchived || !target.Repo.IsDependenciesEnabled(ctx) |
| User must have write permission on the target issue to create/remove dependencies | authorization | !targetPerm.CanWriteIssuesOrPulls(target.IsPull) |
| User must have read permission on the dependency issue | authorization | !dependencyPerm.CanReadIssuesOrPulls(dependency.IsPull) |
| Circular dependencies are not allowed (A depends on B and B depends on A) | business_logic | issueDepExists(ctx, dep.ID, issue.ID) == true |
| Duplicate dependencies are not allowed | business_logic | issueDepExists(ctx, issue.ID, dep.ID) == true |
| Creating/removing a dependency adds comments to both issues in the relationship | business_logic | Always after successful create/remove |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Different repo and AllowCrossRepositoryDependencies=false | 400 | CrossRepositoryDependencies not enabled | False |
| Dependency already exists | 500 | internal error | False |
| Would create circular dependency | 500 | internal error | False |

### Error Paths

- **Issue not found** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **Cross-repo deps disabled** → ctx.JSON(400) → 400
- **Repo archived or deps disabled** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **No write perm on target** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **Circular dependency** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
